items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps the routine gentle while the skin looks uneven and a little dry.
Niacinamide is a gentle daily step that helps skin look smoother and less red over time.
A ceramide moisturizer helps dry-looking skin feel comfortable and supports the skin barrier.
A daily mineral SPF 50 helps keep skin looking even and protects it from sun every morning.

response.routine_note: Use the cleanser, niacinamide, moisturizer and SPF in the morning, and the first three at night, giving it 8 to 12 weeks before judging results. Since how your skin looks is affecting your mood and your willingness to go out, it is worth talking to a dermatologist or doctor, because that is more than a shop product can address.
